experiment.title: Multi-curve coordinate SGCP matched-density frontier protocol v2
experiment.objective: Implement and independently audit exact-or-gap support frontiers at matched constrained-label budgets, corrected additive expansion and energy, and matched-null effects for three coordinate predicate families across generated 5-8 bit prime-order curves.

matched_null.ranking: SHA-256 of a domain-separated tuple containing protocol, curve record, B, null replicate, and x

curve_acceptance.model: short Weierstrass y^2=x^3+ax+b over F_p with p>3
curve_acceptance.group_order: prime q with exact requested bit length
curve_acceptance.generator: least affine point in canonical (x,y) order; nonidentity points generate because q is prime

optimizer.objective: for each absolute constrained-label cap C, maximize retained final support subject to constrained_count<=C, then minimize constrained labels and public edges, maximize retained degree-four maxima, and choose the lexicographically least witness list
optimizer.certificate: at every cap, an exact optimum or certified integer lower and upper primary-support bounds plus the complete live frontier when capped

inputs.canonical_launch_gate: Independent theory, accounting, and red-team GO plus a frozen hash-complete execution plan are required.

controls: Reproduce the frozen p=19,a=2,b=9,q=23 least-x P2 primary optima and retained supports for B in {4,6,8}.
Re-run all twelve hash-bound EXP-SGCP-EMBED-001 abstract and EC controls without weakening their predicate vectors.
On exhaustive small graphs, exact-compare every subset with graph independence and direct closure injectivity.
Exact-compare branch-and-bound results with exhaustive optimization on frozen empty, complete, path, cycle, coverage-tie, and lexicographic-tie graphs.
Force a node cap on a frozen optimizer fixture and verify lower <= optimum <= upper with a nonzero reported gap.
Exact-compare every density-budget optimum with exhaustive enumeration on frozen small graphs, including infeasible nonempty caps and equal-support different-density ties.
Recompute every serialized live frontier state and its upper bound without executing producer search code.
Verify every predicate family selects exactly B/2 distinct admissible x-roots and both signs over each root.
Verify Mobius poles and two-map duplicate roots are rejected or deterministically filled without changing B.
Verify hash-x null selection is deterministic, domain-separated, cardinality-matched, and negation-symmetric.
Reject singular, trace-zero, anomalous, j=0, and j=1728 curve fixtures.
A coordinate-decoding mutation must fail compatibility while leaving the abstract formal checks unchanged.
A non-homomorphic permutation of public point coordinates must fail the semantic differential.
Private optimizer/frontier data and final-support witness maps must be separately charged and hashed.

primary: exact embedding axiom vector and direct-final-edge count
per-cap optimizer retained-support lower bound, upper bound, absolute gap, and exactness status
balanced-raw, full-eight-fold, and retained absolute final support with unambiguous denominators
constrained-label cap, attained constrained count, exact delta, and certified support frontier
paired coordinate-versus-null support difference at the same absolute cap, with exact rows separated from unresolved rows
secondary: factor-base, 2F, 4F, and 8F support, formal-multiset collision energy, and multinomially weighted ordered-tuple additive energy
candidate, eligible, rejected, conflict-edge, component, degree, and degeneracy counts
optimizer nodes, frontier nodes, pruning reasons, incumbent updates, and termination reason
public operation-table bytes and separately charged private optimizer/audit bytes
field multiplications, inversions, point additions, hashes, memory, and wall time
curve draw count, curve invariants, predicate parameters, selected roots, and root polynomial

stopping_rules: Do not create a canonical run while status is review_required or maximum_runs is zero.
Stop canonical execution at the first inherited-control, curve-filter, predicate-cardinality, semantic, source-binding, or verifier mismatch.
Stop a cap at the frozen node or wall budget and serialize the complete optimizer frontier needed to justify its upper bound.
Do not substitute a new predicate, curve, factor-base size, null count, objective, or optimizer cap after approval.
Development runs must remain under development/ and cannot be cited as hypothesis evidence.
invalidation_rules: The builder or public result contains scalar indices, a scalar table, or scalar-derived factor-base selection.
A curve violates any preregistered acceptance condition or a matched row uses a different curve or B.
A factor base omits one sign, includes a 2-torsion fiber, or has the wrong number of distinct roots.
Graph feasibility disagrees with direct closure injectivity on any exhaustive audit row.
An optimizer bound fails to contain the independently known optimum on any control.
A nonzero-gap cap is labeled optimal or contributes to a positive matched-family gate.
A candidate and null are compared at different absolute constrained-label caps.
Formal-multiset collision energy is labeled or interpreted as ordered-tuple additive energy.
Private search state or final-pair witnesses are counted as free public structured advice.
Any direct retained-4F by retained-4F edge is present in the public operation.
A toy family effect is interpreted as an exponent, relation-generation, target-descent, or ECDLP result.
experiment.success_criterion: After approval and two valid canonical roles, confirm the scoped hypothesis only if every interpreted embedding passes all exact checks; at least 90 percent of all coordinate and matched-null cap cells have zero primary gap and every other gap is at most max(1,ceil(0.05q)); one fixed coordinate family has median retained/balanced-raw support at least 0.25 at the full q cap in every bit stratum; and at floor(q/2) or floor(3q/4) that same family exceeds the paired four-null median by at least max(1,ceil(0.05q)) retained targets in at least three strata with a positive sign in at least 75 percent of exact curve-B-cap comparisons.
experiment.falsification_criterion: With valid controls and sufficiently resolved cap cells, return a scoped WEAKEN or REJECT if no fixed coordinate family meets both full-cap persistence and matched-budget null-advantage predictions. Record COLLAPSE as a narrower negative if every coordinate family has median retained/balanced-raw support below 0.10 at the full cap in at least three strata. Infrastructure, implementation, or unresolved-bound failures are INCONCLUSIVE, not mathematical evidence.
